_comment: Copy to ~/.flywheel/test-slots.json and fill in values
_setup: Create bots at discord.com/developers/applications, channels in Discord server
_role: slot.role selects the GeoForge3D identity.md to source from when slot.identitySource is absent (legacy fallback): 'cos' → .lead/cos-lead/identity.md, 'lead' → .lead/product-lead/identity.md. Required for backward compat.
_forumChannel: FLY-115 v1.24.2 Gap C: forumChannelId is OPTIONAL. Create a Forum-type channel in the test guild per slot and grant the bot VIEW_CHANNEL, SEND_MESSAGES, SEND_MESSAGES_IN_THREADS, CREATE_PUBLIC_THREADS, MANAGE_THREADS. Omitting / empty string → test-deploy.sh logs a WARN and Bridge starts without forum support (ProjectConfig.forumChannel is absent rather than empty — packages/teamlead/src/ProjectConfig.ts:100-110).
_deptFields: FLY-127: dept-aware fields (all OPTIONAL, backward compatible). 'department' is a human label like 'product-test' / 'ops-test' / 'finance-test' — informational only. 'deptLabel' is the Linear label this slot owns (e.g. 'Product-Test'); when set, FLYWHEEL_PROJECTS lead.match.labels becomes [deptLabel] so PR #170's department registry actually enforces scope in tests. 'identitySource' overrides the role→subdir map and lets a slot source from any GeoForge3D .lead/<name>/identity.md (e.g. 'ops-lead' for an ops test slot). Slots WITHOUT these fields keep FLY-96 behavior (match.labels=['*'], no dept enforcement).
